thread:
Incident Bot: paging: high error rate detected for canary group aurelia-vpc-canary (customer: Aurelia Health). 5xx surge, 95th latency spike. Autoescalate to ops-oncall. https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/INC-2170041122 :rotating_light:
Ops Oncall: I'm on it. I'm seeing 5xx from model runtime between 17:45-17:47 UTC, approx 18% error ratio on canary. Starting investigation.
Sanjay: pinging logs, attaching initial error samples.
Sanjay: ```json
{"error":"kv_cache_eviction_failure","stack":"runtime/kv.go:214"}
{"error":"oom","details":"tensor alloc failed on 16GB device"}
```
Elaine: timeline? how much traffic hit the canary?
Ops Oncall: ~120 rps, ~10% of Aurelia's traffic routed to the canary variant (pinned artifact aurelia-v2.3.1-quant@sha:abc1234).
Maria: customer impact? any retries?
Customer Success: Aurelia reports elevated latencies in their UI and a few 502s, they marked severity P2. They are asking for ETA and isolation plan.
Kevin: Can we divert Aurelia entirely off the canary? Prefer immediate isolation.
Ops Oncall: yes. Plan A: divert Aurelia traffic to reserved dedicated pool (aurelia-reserved-1) and pin to stable artifact (aurelia-v2.2.9-fp16@sha:fff999). Plan B: if divert fails, kill canary pods. I want a quick pin and restart.
Sanjay: rolling route change command ready: `redwoodctl route update --tenant aurelia --route canary --weight 0`
Deploy Bot: action queued: route-change by ops-oncall pending confirmation.
Elaine: I'll run the route update and then the artifact pin. After route update, run `redwoodctl deployment pin --tenant aurelia --artifact aurelia-v2.2.9-fp16@sha:fff999 --reason "canary regression 5xx"`
Ops Oncall: do it. Also start logs/metrics capture for postmortem. Create a recording link.
Elaine: route update applied: `route canary -> 0%` confirmed. Traffic now at 0 rps to canary. Monitoring shows error rate dropping for customer requests.
Ops Oncall: good. Now pin artifact to stable and restart service across dedicated pool.
Elaine: pinning artifact... ```bash
redwoodctl deployment pin --tenant aurelia --artifact aurelia-v2.2.9-fp16@sha:fff999 --force
```
Deploy Bot: deployment.pin started (job id: job-2170041122-01). ETA ~ 2m.
Sanjay: while pin runs, I want to inspect canary host-level: found recurring GPU OOM on node g4-012 causing partial process crashes. Kernel logs show repeated allocation failures. Might be a quantization kernel regression in the canary build.
Kevin: good catch. That suggests canary artifact is the root cause, not infra. We should keep node isolated for now.
Ops Oncall: quarantine canary nodes: `redwoodctl node quarantine --pool canary-aurelia --until 2170044722 --reason "suspected canary artifact causing OOM"`
Elaine: quarantine applied. Node metrics show CPU stable after quarantine.
Maria: CS updated Aurelia: "We've diverted you to a stable variant and are rolling back the canary. We'll follow up with RCA and timeline." They asked for a short incident summary.
Customer Success: shared with Aurelia leadership and asked to hold any internal deploys for 1 hour. They're appreciative of the quick diversion.
Deploy Bot: deployment.pin job completed: job-2170041122-01 SUCCEEDED. Services restarted on stable artifact.
Ops Oncall: verifying end-to-end: synthetic probe for Aurelia shows 200/latency back to baseline. 5xx count down to normal.
Sanjay: capturing logs from canary artifact for postmortem. Saved snapshot to s3://redwood-incidents/aurelia/2170041122/snapshot.tar.gz
Elaine: initiating canary artifact rollback on registry: mark aurelia-v2.3.1-quant as quarantined, tag stable as 'pinned-for-aurelia'.
Kevin: recommend disabling auto-promote for the model family until we've RCA'd. Also schedule a canary replay test in staging for the quant kernel.
Ops Oncall: taking responsibility for incident until closure. Handoff note: Elaine will stay as responder for the next 30m for warm handoff to next oncall.
Elaine: logging timeline and action items in incident ticket: https://issues.redwood.internal/INC-2170041122. Items: 1) RCA for quant kernel allocation regression 2) improve canary health gating 3) add alert rule to detect rapid OOM spikes per canary 4) update runbook to include immediate route-divert steps.
Maria: Customer follow-up: schedule a post-incident call with Aurelia CS + eng for 09:00 UTC tomorrow.
Ops Oncall: closing loop: Are we comfortable moving to monitor-only state?
Sanjay: yes. All metrics stable for 6m.
Customer Success: Aurelia confirmed degraded experience resolved on their side. They accept the mitigation.
Ops Oncall: Status -> Mitigated. Assigning P1 -> P2 transition. Will create postmortem draft. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
